environment.description: Laravel 10.x application running on PHP 8.2 with FPM, deployed on AWS ECS Fargate containers (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM). PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode. Default PHP pcre.backtrack_limit of 1000000. No request timeout configured at application level beyond the default 30s PHP max_execution_time. ALB health checks on /health endpoint. No rate limiting configured.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB, no WAF
